status.en: 24 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 24 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Syrian security forces killed two of their own personnel during a raid on an ISIL cell near Damascus and the Lebanese border. Israeli forces carried out a raid in southern Syria that killed a Syrian man with Down syndrome in Daraa. Syrian internal security forces launched an operation against an ISIS cell in Rankous, resulting in two security personnel deaths, and reported clashes with suspected ISIS fighters elsewhere in the Damascus countryside. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker drepte to av sine egne personell under et raid på en ISIL-celle nær Damaskus og den libanesiske grensen. Israelske styrker gjennomførte et raid i sørlige Syria som drepte en syrisk mann med Down-syndrom i Daraa. Syriske interne sikkerhetsstyrker igangsatte en operasjon mot en IS-celle i Rankous, noe som førte til to sikkerhetspersonells dødsfall, og rapporterte sammenstøt med mistenkte IS-kjemper andre steder på Damaskus-landet. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
